_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: If I were given the chance to start life over, with one guaranteed outcome, I would choose to be in love with you again. I would choose that every single time, no matter how many times I was asked. Loving you has been the greatest honor of my life. Every other aspect of life cannot even compare. Everything else in this life is replaceable, but our love is something I could never replicate, no matter how hard I tried. A one of a kind feeling that cannot even be put into words. It's like every single good thing in this world balled into one. You have given me hope in a time in my life where I felt like there was nothing worth it in this world. You gave me strength to get back up when I felt like I was knocked down by my illness and that there was no hope of me getting back up. But there’s one thing I don’t think I've expressed to you enough. When we were upstate this past weekend, and you looked at the picture frames with all the pictures of me when I was four to eight years old. It took my memory back to those times. The most shy and awkward kid you could ever imagine. Being told I was 'getting chubby' since I was four. Having a gap in my teeth the width of the Grand Canyon. Living every day with the hope that I wouldn't do something to embarrass myself. At school, at sports, at home. The times when nearly everyone in my grade would be in on a joke at my expense. The time when an entire grade of kids were invited to a birthday party except me. From the second I started to think of the concepts of love, girlfriends, and dating, all I ever imagined was having a girlfriend who truly let me be me. Someone who would let me be my emotional self and never make me feel judged. From as early as five years old, when my mom taught me how to pray. I would pray every night before bed this exact prayer. 'Please, dear Lord, bless me with a girl who loves you as I do. Bless me with a girl who I can care for and love forever. A girl who will love me equally, and for us to have a beautiful life, and a healthy family.' I prayed that exact prayer nearly every single day until I met you. When I realized what God had put in front of me. Now, of course, I still pray for the beautiful life and healthy family. But the first part of my prayer has been answered. I still sit back in awe of it. I can’t believe how blessed I am to have you, and I will feel like that until I take my last breath. You are my everything, pookie bear. You’re literally the answer to my prayers. I love loving you. You are amazing. You are selfless, kind, empathetic, in all of the ways that I am lacking. You’ve taught me more than you can imagine in this time that we’ve been together. You’re so hard working and passionate about things you love, and it inspires me constantly. I love you for all of eternity, pookie bear, and I can’t wait to tell you that for the rest of our lives.
